players.product: data center buildings owned and operated for GPU clusters (owner / operator of the Columbus, Georgia site hosting Axe Compute's B300 cluster)

quarterly_data.signal: Duos Technologies 8-K (LD Micro investor presentation): Duos develops and operates modular AI colocation sites of 10 to 30 megawatts - it provides shell, power, cooling and security and the customer brings the compute; the 10 MW hyperscaler agreement (announced July 16) is expected to be available in Q4 2026 and the Columbus campus is in service for a hyperscale anchor customer. Illustrative unit economics at the contracted colocation rate: <$6.0M of capital per IT megawatt, $185 per kW per month (about $2.2M of annual revenue per megawatt), about $1.0M of site EBITDA per megawatt per year and payback under 3 years. Footprint: edge data centers at Amarillo (2), Abilene, Corpus Christi and Victoria, Texas, with Pampa, Texas announced; 15 edge data center pods deployed through year-end 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: 10 to 30 MW sites; <$6.0M per IT megawatt; $185 per kW per month; 15 pods through year-end 2025
